predicates.label: Invoice template
predicates.description: Name of the mxsat template used to invoice this client

predicates.label: Deposit rule
predicates.description: How the owner recognizes this client's deposits: type=<tx_type>[;account=<account key>][;amount=<cents>]

predicates.label: Draft id
predicates.description: mxsat draft id (template-SeriesFolio)

predicates.label: CFDI id
predicates.description: mxsat pseudonym of the stamped invoice (from its UUID)

predicates.label: Invoice total
predicates.description: Invoice total in cents

predicates.label: Invoice subtotal
predicates.description: Invoice subtotal in cents

predicates.label: Taxes transferred
predicates.description: Transferred taxes on the invoice, in cents

predicates.label: Taxes withheld
predicates.description: Withheld taxes on the invoice, in cents

predicates.label: Series
predicates.description: Invoice series

predicates.label: Folio
predicates.description: Invoice folio

predicates.label: Period invoiced
predicates.description: YYYY-MM named in the invoice description, when there is one

predicates.label: Invoice date
predicates.description: Date of the invoice (planned for a draft, actual once issued), at noon

predicates.label: VAT treatment
predicates.description: rate_0, rate_8, rate_16, exempt or mixed, read from the invoice

predicates.label: Payment form
predicates.description: SAT FormaPago code on the invoice

predicates.label: Capture sheet
predicates.description: Path of the local capture sheet the owner opens; the agent never reads it

predicates.label: Accepted with differences
predicates.description: The owner kept an invoice that differs from its draft

predicates.label: Reason
predicates.description: Why, in the owner's words

predicates.label: Obligation kind
predicates.description: sat_declaration, accountant_fee or other

predicates.label: Obligation
predicates.description: What is owed, in the owner's words

predicates.label: Amount owed
predicates.description: Amount to pay, in cents

predicates.label: Due
predicates.description: Last day to pay, at noon

predicates.label: Period
predicates.description: YYYY-MM the obligation is for

predicates.label: Receipt id
predicates.description: mxsat pseudonym of the declaration receipt

predicates.label: Capture line valid until
predicates.description: Last day the capture line can be used, at noon

predicates.label: For deposit
predicates.description: Bank transaction this invoice or decision is about

predicates.label: For client
predicates.description: Client the invoice is for

predicates.label: Paid with
predicates.description: Bank transaction that paid an obligation
